title: Orbital / Public-domain demo
creator: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5
description: Five nonexclusive, processed satellite images. These are a free public-domain demonstration, not original photography by this studio.

files.title: Shoal Complex
files.description: Tidal sand ridges and channels near the Schooner Cays, rendered in blue and turquoise. Source and rights: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/shoal-complex
files.credit: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5

files.title: Tapestry
files.description: Geological patterns in the Asharah fault zone, close to the Yemen border. Source and rights: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/tapestry
files.credit: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5

files.title: Serene Expressions
files.description: Sediment flowing off the Louisiana coast creates soft, layered color. Source and rights: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/serene-expressions
files.credit: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5

files.title: Icy Vortex
files.description: Floating sea ice traces intricate currents in the Canadian Arctic. Source and rights: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/icy-vortex
files.credit: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5

files.title: Painted Horse
files.description: Volcanic craters and old lava flows shape the northern end of Isabela Island. Source and rights: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/painted-horse
files.credit: U.S. Geological Survey / Earth As Art 5
